title: oncodostigma monospermum
intro: Oncodostigma monospermum, commonly known as Maytham, is a plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Oncodostigma monospermum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the management of conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
